The '''V-35 Courier''', also known as '''V-35 Landspeeder''', was a model of [[landspeeder]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation]]. By the fifteenth [[Standard year|year]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the V-35 was outdated, and therefore inexpensive. At the time, it could often be found on [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]]s such as [[Lothal]].<ref name="FB" /> Five years later, [[Owen Lars|Owen]] and [[Beru Whitesun Lars|Beru Lars]] still owned one of these landspeeders, which they kept on [[Lars homestead|their homestead]] on [[Tatooine]].<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> They used it frequently for trips to [[Anchorhead]], where they bought supplies and sold their hydroponically grown goods.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> The V-35 was characterized by a sharply angular nose, three raised [[repulsorlift]] thrusters, and a large barrel-shaped power plant.<ref name="Head to Head" /> It featured a one-driver, open-air port.<ref name="V-35 Landspeeder" />
